candidates.source_name: BQK — Institucionet Financiare të Licencuara (Central Bank of Kosovo register of licensed financial institutions)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of every licensed bank, microfinance institution, non-bank financial institution (incl. payment/e-money type IFJB), insurer, exchange office and pension fund in Kosovo. This is the master buyer-universe list for A2 tender monitoring: you cannot scan for banking/payments tenders without first naming the licensed institutions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic fetch of the register landing page plus the dated PDF snapshots it links; diff institution names/addresses month-over-month to detect new licences and exits.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for the regulator's register term
queries_used: BQK regjistri i institucioneve financiare të licencuara Kosovë
bqk-kos.org "institucionet financiare" lista bankat institucionet e pagesave licencuara faqja
local_language_terms_used: Banka Qendrore e Republikës së Kosovës

candidates.source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (dated PDF snapshot)
candidates.why_relevant: The machine-collectable artefact behind the register: a dated PDF with full legal names, addresses and contact details of each licensed institution. Ideal seed file for an entity table (aliases, legal suffixes SH.A./J.S.C.) used to match tender award notices.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch and parse the PDF; keep every dated version for historical entity resolution. Older versions exist under /edu/wp-content/uploads/.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from BQK register page / sq search
queries_used: BQK regjistri i institucioneve financiare të licencuara Kosovë
local_language_terms_used: Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara

candidates.source_name: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës / Kosovo Banking Association (KBA)
candidates.why_relevant: Sector association founded 2002; its member list is the standard shorthand enumeration of commercial banks in Kosovo, and the association also publishes sector positions and events that reveal joint infrastructure projects (cards, instant payments) preceding tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Browser-based fetch with realistic headers (plain fetch returned 403); scrape the Anëtarët/members section and the news feed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for the association's official name
queries_used: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës anëtarët lista bankat
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch of https://www.bankassoc-kos.com/Al/rreth-nesh/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden — hypothesis: bot defence, site likely live (unverified).

candidates.source_name: FSDK — Fondi i Sigurimit të Depozitave në Kosovë, Bankat Anëtare
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory deposit-insurance membership is compulsory for licensed banks, so this list is an independent cross-check on the BQK bank universe and updates when a bank enters/exits. FSDK itself is also a small contracting authority (IT/DRC projects).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the members page (sq and en variants) on a quarterly cadence; also monitor fsdk.org news for its own procurement/DRC projects.
queries_used: FSDK bankat anëtare sigurimi i depozitave Kosovë list members
local_language_terms_used: Fondi i Sigurimit të Depozitave në Kosovë

candidates.source_name: ARBK — Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve të Kosovës (official business registry)
candidates.why_relevant: Sole institution for business registration in Kosovo; the authoritative source of legal names, unique business numbers, legal form, owners/authorised representatives and activity codes for both contracting-authority-adjacent public enterprises and candidate suppliers. Needed to resolve tender bidder names to real entities.
candidates.access_status: public search; some services require an account
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted lookups per company name/number rather than bulk crawl; use the public search pages. For bulk, prefer the mirrors/APIs listed separately.
queries_used: ARBK regjistri i bizneseve Kosovë kërkim biznesi arbk.rks-gov.net

candidates.source_name: ARBK Open (arbk.org) — open mirror of the Kosovo business registry
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party open mirror allowing search over registrations, owners, activities and statistics from the ARBK public registry — far more collectable than the official ASP.NET forms, and useful for bulk supplier/ownership enrichment behind tender award analysis.
candidates.legal_status: unofficial mirror of public data — verify terms before bulk use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scripted search/enrichment; always reconcile a sample against official ARBK to measure freshness and error rate.
queries_used: Kosovo regjistri i pronarëve përfitues beneficial ownership ARBK opendata biznes dataset

candidates.source_name: Open Data Kosovo — Open Businesses (scraped ARBK dataset, 170k+ businesses)
candidates.why_relevant: Civic-tech dataset explicitly built to link business registration data with public procurement and asset declarations — exactly the join needed to go from an award notice to a company profile and its owners.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off bulk download as a baseline entity table; check last-update date, as civic datasets go stale.
queries_used: Kosovo regjistri i pronarëve përfitues beneficial ownership ARBK opendata biznes dataset

candidates.source_name: OpenCorporates — Kosovo Business Registration Agency jurisdiction page
candidates.why_relevant: Normalised, queryable copy of Kosovo company records with stable identifiers; useful for cross-border ownership tracing of bidders (Turkish, Slovenian, Austrian, Albanian parents are common in XK banking/IT).
candidates.legal_status: commercial aggregator, licence required for bulk
candidates.suggested_collection_method: API lookups under their terms; avoid bulk scraping.
queries_used: Kosovo regjistri i pronarëve përfitues beneficial ownership ARBK opendata biznes dataset

candidates.source_name: OCCRP Aleph — Kosovo Business Registration Agency dataset
candidates.why_relevant: Investigative-grade indexed copy of ARBK data, searchable by person as well as company — helps expose beneficial owners and directors linking suppliers to bank/public-sector counterparts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Aleph API/entity search for named companies and directors; not for bulk mirroring.
queries_used: Kosovo regjistri i pronarëve përfitues beneficial ownership ARBK opendata biznes dataset

candidates.source_name: KRPP / e-Prokurimi — Lista e Autoriteteve Kontraktuese (list of contracting authorities)
candidates.why_relevant: The definitive enumeration of every entity subject to Kosovo public procurement law — the buyer side of A2. KRPP annual reports state ~165 active contracting authorities plus 16 handled centrally by the Central Procurement Agency. Pairs with the BQK register to define which banking-adjacent bodies (BQK, FSDK, public enterprises, ministries) can issue payment/IT tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the 'Lista e Autoriteteve Kontraktuese' section on the portal and scrape it; supplement with the annual KRPP reports (PDF) which list authorities and their procurement volumes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for contracting-authority list terminology
queries_used: KRPP lista e autoriteteve kontraktuese Kosovë e-prokurimi

candidates.source_name: KRPP annual public procurement reports (Raporti Vjetor)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual reports enumerate contracting authorities, procurement volumes and procedure types — a structural map of who buys how much, letting the buyer list be prioritised rather than treated flat.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF fetch and table extraction from the Raportet Vjetore directory (predictable path pattern per year).
queries_used: KRPP lista e autoriteteve kontraktuese Kosovë e-prokurimi

candidates.source_name: STIKK — Shoqata e TIK e Kosovës, member directory
candidates.why_relevant: The ICT association member directory is the candidate-supplier universe for banking/payments IT tenders: system integrators and distributors that actually bid (CACTTUS, Kosbit, ITD Prishtinë, StarLabs, Ericsson Nikola Tesla branch, BIT Kosova, Panamic ICT). Each member page carries capabilities and vendor authorisations useful for competitor mapping.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /members/ and /en/members/ listing pages, extract per-member profile pages into a supplier table; re-run quarterly to catch new entrants.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) + snowball into individual member pages
queries_used: STIKK anëtarët kompanitë ICT Kosovë member directory

candidates.source_name: Oda Ekonomike e Kosovës (OEK) — Kosovo Chamber of Commerce
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory chamber founded 1962 (Law No. 2004/7) with sectoral departments; its membership and sector-council composition enumerate mid-size Kosovar firms including IT and services suppliers, and its export/investment department publishes company listings.
candidates.access_status: public; full member directory not clearly exposed
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl site sections and event/delegation pages for member company names; consider direct request for the member list.
queries_used: Oda Ekonomike e Kosovës anëtarët direktoriumi kompanive
local_language_terms_used: Ligji për Odën Ekonomike të Kosovës

candidates.source_name: AmCham Kosovo — Membership Directory
candidates.why_relevant: Well-structured, browsable directory (alphabetical and by category, incl. Patron Members) that reliably enumerates banks, payment/fintech firms and IT vendors active in Kosovo — one of the cleanest scrapable actor lists in the market.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the alphabetical listing and category pages; join member names to ARBK for legal identifiers.
queries_used: AmCham Kosovo member directory anëtarët; Oda Ekonomike Gjermano-Kosovare anëtarët

candidates.source_name: OEGJK / KDWV — Oda Ekonomike Gjermano-Kosovare, Lista e plotë e anëtarëve
candidates.why_relevant: German-Kosovar chamber with ~200 members and an explicitly published full member list (including a downloadable member-company document) — a compact enumeration of firms with EU vendor ties, likely bidders/partners on banking IT projects.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the 'Lista e plotë' page and fetch the linked member-company document; re-check annually after the Kuvend (general assembly).
queries_used: AmCham Kosovo member directory anëtarët; Oda Ekonomike Gjermano-Kosovare anëtarët

candidates.source_name: AMIK — Shoqata e Institucioneve Mikrofinanciare të Kosovës, Anëtarët e AMIK
candidates.why_relevant: Enumerates the microfinance/NBFI segment (KEP Trust, KRK, AFK, Kos Invest and others) — a second tier of financial buyers that procure core banking, lending and payment systems and are easily missed if only banks are tracked.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the members page and committee pages; cross-check against the BQK IMF/IFJB list.
queries_used: AMIK Shoqata e Institucioneve Mikrofinanciare Kosovë anëtarët; Shoqata e Siguruesve të Kosovës anëtarët
local_language_terms_used: Shoqata e Institucioneve Mikrofinanciare të Kosovës

candidates.source_name: BKS — Byroja Kosovare e Sigurimit / Shoqata e Sigurimeve të Kosovës
candidates.why_relevant: Insurance bureau/association covering ~14 insurers (12 non-life, 2 life) with mixed domestic/Austrian/Albanian/Slovenian capital. Insurers are adjacent buyers of payment, claims and IT systems, and BKS itself runs sector infrastructure that gets tendered.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape member/insurer listing pages; reconcile with the BQK insurers section of the licensed-institutions register.
queries_used: AMIK Shoqata e Institucioneve Mikrofinanciare Kosovë anëtarët; Shoqata e Siguruesve të Kosovës anëtarët

candidates.source_name: Privredna komora Kosova i Metohije (Serbian-language chamber, Kosovska Mitrovica)
candidates.why_relevant: The only Serbian-language chamber structure covering Serb-majority municipalities in Kosovo; enumerates firms that operate under the parallel/Serbian system and would otherwise be invisible in ARBK-only actor maps. Its links page points onward to Serbian registers (APR) relevant for cross-registered entities.
candidates.legal_status: chamber registered under Serbian law; jurisdictional status contested
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-frequency crawl; snowball its links page into APR (Serbian Business Registers Agency) for entity data.
queries_used: "Privredna komora" Kosovo Severna Mitrovica članovi registar preduzeća

candidates.source_name: RKS Open Data — organisation pages (e.g. Komisioni Rregullativ i Prokurimit Publik)
candidates.why_relevant: The national open-data portal organises datasets by publishing institution, which doubles as a machine-readable list of state bodies (i.e. contracting authorities) and exposes any procurement or registry datasets they publish.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate /organization via the portal API; pull dataset metadata for procurement- and registry-related publishers.
queries_used: KRPP lista e autoriteteve kontraktuese Kosovë e-prokurimi

candidates.source_name: Gzk.rks-gov.net — Gazeta Zyrtare (legal basis defining registers and chambers)
candidates.why_relevant: Law No. 04/L-093 on banks, MFIs and NBFIs defines which entity types must be licensed and registered by BQK; Law No. 2004/7 defines the Chamber; Law No. 04/L-042 defines contracting authorities. These texts tell you what the registers must contain and therefore what is collectable by right.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch of the relevant acts; monitor for amendments that change register scope (e.g. payment institution licensing).
queries_used: BQK regjistri i institucioneve financiare të licencuara Kosovë

candidates.source_name: ARBK Registri i Pengut (pledge register)
candidates.why_relevant: Pledge/collateral register operated alongside ARBK; reveals financing relationships between banks/MFIs and companies, an indirect signal of which institutions are active with which corporate counterparties.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted lookups only; not a bulk source.
queries_used: ARBK regjistri i bizneseve Kosovë kërkim biznesi arbk.rks-gov.net

negative_findings.description: Direct fetch of the Kosovo Banking Association site (https://www.bankassoc-kos.com/Al/rreth-nesh/) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as bot-defended-but-live hypothesis, not dead. Member names were partially recovered indirectly via a member bank's page (bkt-ks.com) and the association's Facebook page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The KBA member list is a primary pointer for the cell; a headless-browser collection path must be provisioned rather than assuming the source is unavailable.

negative_findings.description: Oda Ekonomike e Kosovës (OEK) does not expose a complete, browsable member directory in search-visible pages; only statute, departments and news were reachable.
negative_findings.result_summary: No 'lista e anëtarëve' page located for OEK despite Albanian-language querying.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The statutory chamber would be the broadest supplier enumeration; without a directory, actor discovery must lean on STIKK, AmCham and OEGJK plus ARBK activity-code queries.

negative_findings.description: Albanian-language searching for a debarred/excluded economic operators register ('lista e operatorëve ekonomikë të përjashtuar') returned Republic of Albania results (app.gov.al) rather than Kosovo.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Kosovo (KRPP) debarment/economic-operator register URL confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Shared Albanian terminology causes systematic Albania/Kosovo confusion; all sq queries for this run must be pinned with 'Kosovë', 'KRPP', 'rks-gov.net' to avoid contaminating the source list.

negative_findings.description: The 'Lista e Autoriteteve Kontraktuese' is referenced as a section of the e-Prokurimi portal but no stable deep URL to the list itself was observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the portal root (e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net/Home/) and the annual-report PDFs were observed; the list URL is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must include a navigation step or a browser session against the portal rather than a fixed deep link.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching surfaced only one Kosovo-specific chamber (Privredna komora Kosova i Metohije) and otherwise returned Serbia-proper institutions (APR, PKS regional chambers).
negative_findings.result_summary: No sr-language enumeration of Kosovo-licensed banks, payment firms or IT suppliers was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serb-majority-municipality actors and any sr-language procurement notices risk being under-covered; sr coverage of this cell is currently weak and should not be presented as complete.

negative_findings.description: Searched specifically for a Kosovo beneficial-ownership register ('regjistri i pronarëve përfitues'); no dedicated public BO register URL was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ownership data appears reachable only via ARBK company records and third-party mirrors (ARBK Open, OpenCorporates, OCCRP Aleph).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ownership tracing behind tender awards will depend on registry extracts and aggregators, with the reliability caveats those carry.

coverage_gaps.description: No register specifically enumerating licensed payment institutions / e-money institutions was isolated; they appear folded into the BQK 'institucione financiare jobankare (IFJB)' category without a payments-specific view.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Parse the BQK licensed-institutions PDF by category and extract the IFJB block; check BQK licensing subpages for a payments/e-money licence type page.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language (sr) pointer coverage is thin; only one chamber source found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted sr queries against Kosovo domains (e.g. 'licencirane banke Kosovo', 'javne nabavke Kosovo lista ugovornih organa', 'registar preduzeca Kosovo') and check whether rks-gov.net portals publish sr-language versions.

coverage_gaps.description: No Kosovo register of registered/qualified economic operators or debarred suppliers was located (the sq query resolved to Albania).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query KRPP directly with Kosovo-pinned terms and inspect krpp.rks-gov.net sections; if none exists, derive the supplier universe from award notices plus ARBK activity codes.

coverage_gaps.description: Public enterprises (ndërmarrjet publike) and municipalities as contracting authorities were not separately enumerated in this pass, although many are banking/payments-relevant buyers (utility billing, POS collection).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the public-enterprise list from the Ministry/Public Enterprises unit and the 38 municipalities from kk.rks-gov.net, then join to the KRPP contracting-authority list.

coverage_gaps.description: ARBK's official search is an ASP.NET form-driven site and bulk collection viability is unverified; reliance on third-party mirrors introduces freshness risk.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test the official ARBK search programmatically and benchmark a sample of records against arbk.org and the applifyer API to quantify staleness before choosing a primary path.

brief: Kosovo's actor-enumeration layer is unusually well-defined: BQK's licensed-institutions register (with dated PDF snapshots) fixes the financial buyer universe, KRPP/e-Prokurimi's contracting-authority list fixes the public buyer universe, and ARBK is the single authoritative company register underlying both — with unusually good open mirrors (arbk.org, Open Data Kosovo, OpenCorporates, OCCRP Aleph) that make bulk supplier and ownership enrichment practical. The supplier side is best enumerated through association directories: STIKK for ICT integrators, AmCham Kosovo and OEGJK for structured member lists, plus AMIK and BKS for the microfinance and insurance buyer tiers. Two practical cautions: Albanian-language procurement terminology collides with Albania's own portals and must be jurisdiction-pinned, and Serbian-language coverage of this cell is genuinely thin — only the Kosovska Mitrovica chamber surfaced. The Kosovo Banking Association site returned a 403 and should be treated as bot-defended rather than dead, requiring a browser-based collection path.
